Factoring the Jacobian determinant gives -(a/x²)cos(a/x)U(y)V(z)[A(y)A(z)-B(y)B(z)], A=U’V,B=UV’. Its diagonal large-t coefficient is 2ab³c³(b²-c²)/(3 t^12), independently confirmed symbolically. Parities show nonidentically zero in every orthant when b²≠c², so analytic zero-set theorem gives open dense full-measure rank three. At resonance, every forward-defined orbit enters the plane after one step, so invariant probabilities on Ω∞ are supported there, hence Lebesgue-singular; chain rule bounds iterated ranks. Two intermediate-value constructions yield infinitely many fixed points with nonzero coordinates, removing vacuity. Care required that F(Ω) may include zero and is only contained in the plane {y=z}, not necessarily Δ=Ω∩{y=z}; the final theorem correctly uses the plane and Ω∞.
